Krusader 2.6.2 no longer opens a stopped container as a black screen.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A stopped container shows an error page instead of an empty desktop.** The web client came without a cache header, so browsers kept it for days and loaded it from their cache while the container was off. That ended on a black screen stuck on "connecting". Each load now asks the container first, so a stopped one shows the usual browser or proxy error.
